request_budget.note: The shared active desktop session and Codex CLI internal stream retries make the physical upstream request delta non-isolatable. The logical acceptance invocation cap was exactly 20.

metrics.interpretation: Shared active traffic and Codex CLI multi-turn/retry behavior contaminate the global counters; the delta cannot prove duplicate token accounting.

findings.title: OAuth fast path bypasses Client Key Argon2 verification
findings.evidence: gateway.rs oauth_models_fast_path_avoids_argon2_and_stays_below_local_p95_budget proves 0 Argon2 calls; c1 P50 0.35 ms, c4 P95 1.11 ms, c8 P95 2.27 ms.
findings.recommendation: Keep the direct OAuth fast path and guard it with regression tests.

findings.title: Codex CLI shell task experienced repeated stream disconnect retries
findings.evidence: Five responses_retry warnings occurred before the shell/file task completed. This breaks a strict physical no-retry request budget and inflates latency/token counters.
findings.recommendation: Investigate Relay SSE completion/connection-close semantics and expose a tested zero-retry configuration for acceptance runs.

findings.title: Persisted metrics lack percentiles and TTFB
findings.evidence: metrics table stores totals, success/failure, cumulative latency and estimated tokens only.
findings.recommendation: Persist bounded histograms or rolling P50/P95/P99 and TTFB, split by route/provider/stream mode.

findings.title: Global metrics cannot isolate an acceptance run
findings.evidence: shared desktop traffic and CLI multi-turn/retries changed counters during the run; no request correlation or test-run tag exists.
findings.recommendation: Add request IDs, profile/route dimensions and optional run labels; expose exportable per-window metrics.

findings.title: Isolated temporary session is readable by ID but absent from app-server thread/list
findings.evidence: rollout file and state DB row exist; thread/read succeeds; thread/list returns zero.
findings.recommendation: Reproduce with fresh CODEX_HOME and inspect thread-list source-kind/cwd filters and state backfill timing.

findings.title: Non-streaming token/s is not measurable at Relay client boundary
findings.evidence: non-streaming body arrives as one buffered chunk, making TTFB approximately equal to total time.
findings.recommendation: Report token/s only for streaming responses or instrument upstream event timing inside Relay.
